fusions.name: Skittering Jab
fusions.desc: A quick poke that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Boots
fusions.desc: Darts a ring of jabs around you that deals 6 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Between the Walls
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, raising your move speed by 10% while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Gloom Runner
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
